doctrines.note: Veterancy: Bot Line. Hero pairing: Any. "CC-immunity doctrine is mandatory (1 more button but too op). Then there are different builds which involve full DMG, full block, etc. Favourite of the main shieldmaidens players: 1x CCi + 1x Unit DMG V (can also be block/def) + 1x Block (400 block) or Leadership + 1x Block (300 block, -90 dmg) + 1x Block or Steadfast (+130 def, -6% dmg)." Weapon-swap mechanic underpins the whole build: spear-mode swap-after-hit restores 2% max health/s per soldier for 10s; sword-mode swap-after-hit gives +500 Piercing/Slashing Armour Penetration per soldier for 10s; the swap itself carries a CC-immunity effect (resets stance, removes existing CC) and can be stacked indefinitely off a single random hit. "When you have time": sword mode, charge (spell 1, 20% atk buff), swap to spear, spell 1 to enter formation, spell 2 cover-commander, swap back to sword and freeze inputs — don't X-move or shield-bash or cover-commander cancels (CC-immunity doctrine is safe to use). "When you DON'T have time": start in spear mode, spell 1 formation, spell 2 cover-commander, swap to sword and freeze inputs, same cancel risk. On downtime, weapon-swap back-to-back after landing at least one hit on first engage; repeat each time both swaps are off cooldown — high skill-cap in optimising. Cover-commander's hidden passive damage-reduction decays over time (theory value 60%->30% over 5s per OP), so reset it before a fight when possible. Sword-mode's shield-bash (spell 2) ends in a weaker cover-commander than the spear-mode version — "don't get baited!" One of the most micro-intensive units in the game per the OP's own framing ("together with phalanx, by far the most micro intensive... of the game"). Edit timestamp (2026-05-26) pre-dates the 2026-06-25 Chaos patch anchor; doctrine/build guidance flagged for revalidation against current season (not staleAsOfPatch per arbitration ruleset — Shieldmaidens is not on the 13-unit Chaos shortlist, so no forced flag, but noting pre-patch authorship per instructions).

steps.text: Be in sword mode; spell 1 to charge (void-cast for 20% atk buff to allies+self); spell 3 to swap to spear; spell 1 to enter formation, wait for the defence buff; spell 2 to activate cover-commander; spell 3 to swap back to sword and DON'T touch anything else (X-move or shield-bash cancels cover-commander; CC-immunity doctrine is still safe to use).
Be in spear mode; spell 1 to enter formation, wait for the defence buff; spell 2 to activate cover-commander; spell 3 to swap to sword and freeze inputs the same way as the 'have time' line.
Weapon-swap back-to-back after landing at least one hit on the first engage; repeat every time both swaps are off cooldown again. High skill-cap in optimising the loop.
